section_summary: This section records Japanese public vessels’ visits to American ports in late 1935 and 1936, especially the SUNOSAKI, ERIMO, ONDO, and a planned training squadron cruise. State, Navy, War, Treasury, and Labor correspondence arranges customary courtesies while repeatedly addressing vessels’ changes to announced arrival dates. Naval and military reports also discuss officer rosters, the TSURUMI’s activities in Hawaii, and a reported sighting near Midway Island.

subfiles.title: Warning on unannounced vessel schedule changes
subfiles.about: State asks for advance diplomatic notice and adherence to announced port arrival dates.
subfiles.summary: The conclusion of an earlier note explains the inconvenience caused by changed arrival dates.

subfiles.title: Letter to Secretary Swanson on KAIO MARU and ONDO
subfiles.about: State reports its warning to Japan about early arrivals and insufficient notice.
subfiles.summary: Hull says the ambassador is being asked to secure reliable schedules and earlier inquiries.

subfiles.title: Proposed SUNOSAKI visit to Iloilo
subfiles.about: Japan requests approval and courtesies for SUNOSAKI’s January 31–February 2 Iloilo call.
subfiles.summary: The transport would replenish coal, water, and food under Captain Nagaichi Matsunaga.

subfiles.title: SUNOSAKI notice to the Navy
subfiles.about: State informs Navy of SUNOSAKI’s Iloilo visit and its request to War for courtesies.
subfiles.summary: State relays the proposed resupply call and says War is being asked to assist.

subfiles.title: Approval of SUNOSAKI visit
subfiles.about: State accepts SUNOSAKI’s Iloilo call and contacts other federal departments.
subfiles.summary: The visit is agreeable to State, which seeks the customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: SUNOSAKI request to the War Department
subfiles.about: State requests customary facilities for SUNOSAKI at Iloilo.
subfiles.summary: The note gives the January 31–February 2 itinerary and advises that Navy is informed.

subfiles.title: War Department reply on SUNOSAKI
subfiles.about: War orders Philippine authorities to extend courtesies to SUNOSAKI.
subfiles.summary: The Philippine Department and High Commissioner are to be informed.

subfiles.title: Handwritten file note
subfiles.about: A handwritten note concerns the vessel file, but most text is illegible.
subfiles.summary: The note is too indistinct to identify its action reliably.

subfiles.title: Report on TSURUMI’s Honolulu visit
subfiles.about: The commandant reports TSURUMI’s early arrival, activities, personnel, and difficulties obtaining an officer roster.
subfiles.summary: TSURUMI arrived at Honolulu on December 4, about a day early, and took on limited supplies. The report describes shore leave, Japanese newspaper accounts, an officer list, and the failure to obtain an official roster. It also recounts observations of sailors ashore and a troubling visit by several sailors to a kindergarten.

subfiles.title: Memorandum on SUNOSAKI notification
subfiles.about: State discusses a reported SUNOSAKI call before receiving formal diplomatic notice.
subfiles.summary: Officials insist that the new procedure requires notification through diplomatic channels.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of SUNOSAKI visit
subfiles.about: Navy raises no objection to SUNOSAKI’s Iloilo visit.
subfiles.summary: Naval commanders have been advised to provide customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Navy complaint about early arrivals
subfiles.about: Navy asks State to press Japan to follow announced vessel schedules.
subfiles.summary: Navy cites repeated early arrivals and suspects some changes may be deliberate.

subfiles.title: State reply on vessel schedules
subfiles.about: State says it has already asked the Japanese Ambassador for adherence to schedules.
subfiles.summary: Hull refers Navy to State’s January 20 communication.

subfiles.title: Far Eastern Affairs note on two-week notice
subfiles.about: A note records the new two-week diplomatic notification procedure.
subfiles.summary: It summarizes Peiping despatch 155 on reciprocal public-vessel visits.

subfiles.title: Peiping despatch forwarding naval telegram
subfiles.about: The embassy forwards a naval telegram on changed reciprocal port-visit procedures.
subfiles.summary: Johnson sends the telegram for State’s information and copies the embassies at Nanking and Tokyo.

subfiles.title: Naval radio on reciprocal notification procedure
subfiles.about: The telegram replaces earlier arrangements with diplomatic notice at least two weeks before public-vessel visits.
subfiles.summary: The reciprocal procedure begins January 1, 1936, and includes U.S. possessions and the Philippines.

subfiles.title: Proposed ERIMO itinerary
subfiles.about: Japan requests courtesies for ERIMO at Los Angeles and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: ERIMO, commanded by Naozaburo Iribune, would carry crude oil and replenish supplies.

subfiles.title: ERIMO notice to California governor
subfiles.about: State requests customary courtesies for ERIMO’s planned calls.
subfiles.summary: The note supplies the Los Angeles and Honolulu itinerary.

subfiles.title: ERIMO notice to Agriculture
subfiles.about: State requests customary courtesies for ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: The note gives ERIMO’s planned Los Angeles and Honolulu dates.

subfiles.title: ERIMO notice to Labor
subfiles.about: State requests customary courtesies for ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: The note gives ERIMO’s planned Los Angeles and Honolulu dates.

subfiles.title: ERIMO notice to Navy
subfiles.about: State asks Navy to extend customary courtesies to ERIMO if it has no objection.
subfiles.summary: The note describes ERIMO’s oil transport and resupply itinerary.

subfiles.title: ERIMO notice to Interior
subfiles.about: State requests customary courtesies for ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: The note gives ERIMO’s planned Los Angeles and Honolulu dates.

subfiles.title: ERIMO notice to War
subfiles.about: State requests customary courtesies for ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: The note gives ERIMO’s planned Los Angeles and Honolulu dates.

subfiles.title: ERIMO notice to Treasury
subfiles.about: State requests customary courtesies for ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: The note gives ERIMO’s planned Los Angeles and Honolulu dates.

subfiles.title: State approval of ERIMO visits
subfiles.about: State approves ERIMO’s calls and contacts interested departments.
subfiles.summary: The note acknowledges the proposed Los Angeles and Honolulu visits.

subfiles.title: Handwritten Far Eastern Affairs note
subfiles.about: A handwritten note discusses consultations, but its substance is largely illegible.
subfiles.summary: Only the date and fragments of the discussion are readable.

subfiles.title: Note on Navy review of Japanese vessel personnel
subfiles.about: Commander Hill asks State to defer action while Navy investigates personnel concerns.
subfiles.summary: The note mentions a rumor that Japanese vessels exchange personnel with shore parties.

subfiles.title: Navy request for views on officer rosters
subfiles.about: Navy seeks State’s view of Japanese crews’ refusal to supply officer rosters.
subfiles.summary: Navy forwards the Fourteenth Naval District report and asks how to handle future requests.

subfiles.title: Fourteenth Naval District report on officer rosters
subfiles.about: The commandant documents unsuccessful requests for officer rosters aboard TSURUMI and SATA.
subfiles.summary: Japanese captains and Consul-General Tamura declined or could not provide official lists. The report recommends comparing rosters at San Pedro and Honolulu because of possible intelligence activity or personnel changes, and asks what information American vessels provide in Japanese ports.

subfiles.title: State postpones reply on rosters
subfiles.about: State holds its response on officer rosters pending Navy investigation.
subfiles.summary: The postponement follows an oral suggestion from a Navy officer.

subfiles.title: File note on proposed training-squadron visit
subfiles.about: A referenced letter seeks cooperation for a Japanese training squadron’s California visit.
subfiles.summary: It mentions free admission to the California Pacific International Exposition.

subfiles.title: Far Eastern Affairs note on Pacific islands report
subfiles.about: A report of Japanese interest in American Pacific islands is retained for reference.
subfiles.summary: The writer recommends filing it without immediate action.

subfiles.title: Military Intelligence distribution sheet
subfiles.about: A routing sheet lists offices that may receive the attached intelligence report.
subfiles.summary: It includes information, filing, and return options.

subfiles.title: Report on TSURUMI near Midway
subfiles.about: A cable-ship captain reports TSURUMI cruising near Midway and heading toward Wake Island.
subfiles.summary: Captain Piltz of the Dickenson reportedly observed TSURUMI off Midway at night. Patton recommends informing State so Japan can be told the activity was noticed.

subfiles.title: War Department reply on ERIMO
subfiles.about: War orders commanders in California and Hawaii to extend courtesies to ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Instructions are sent to the Ninth Corps Area and Hawaiian Department.

subfiles.title: Treasury reply on ERIMO
subfiles.about: Treasury authorizes customs collectors to assist ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: The Los Angeles and Honolulu collectors will provide customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Navy acknowledgment of schedule complaint
subfiles.about: Navy thanks State for promptly raising inaccurate arrival information with Japan.
subfiles.summary: The letter acknowledges State’s action before Navy’s own request arrived.

subfiles.title: Labor reply on ERIMO
subfiles.about: Immigration officials are told to extend lawful courtesies to ERIMO’s personnel.
subfiles.summary: The reply repeats ERIMO’s announced itinerary.

subfiles.title: Copy of Labor reply on ERIMO
subfiles.about: A second copy records immigration instructions for ERIMO’s personnel.
subfiles.summary: It repeats the instruction to extend courtesies consistent with immigration rules.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of ERIMO visits
subfiles.about: Navy has no objection to ERIMO’s proposed visits.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities will be informed.

subfiles.title: Proposed ONDO itinerary
subfiles.about: Japan requests courtesies for ONDO at Los Angeles and Hilo.
subfiles.summary: The transport, commanded by Michiaki Kamada, would obtain crude oil and replenish supplies.

subfiles.title: ONDO notice to California governor
subfiles.about: State requests customary courtesies for ONDO’s planned visits.
subfiles.summary: The note gives the Los Angeles and Hilo itinerary.

subfiles.title: ONDO notice to Agriculture
subfiles.about: State requests customary courtesies for ONDO.
subfiles.summary: The note gives ONDO’s planned Los Angeles and Hilo dates.

subfiles.title: ONDO notice to Interior
subfiles.about: State requests customary courtesies for ONDO.
subfiles.summary: The note gives ONDO’s planned Los Angeles and Hilo dates.

subfiles.title: ONDO notice to Labor
subfiles.about: State requests customary courtesies for ONDO.
subfiles.summary: The note gives ONDO’s planned Los Angeles and Hilo dates.

subfiles.title: ONDO notice to Navy
subfiles.about: State asks Navy to extend customary courtesies to ONDO if it has no objection.
subfiles.summary: The note describes ONDO’s oil and resupply calls.

subfiles.title: ONDO notice to Treasury
subfiles.about: State requests customary courtesies for ONDO.
subfiles.summary: The note gives ONDO’s planned Los Angeles and Hilo dates.

subfiles.title: ONDO notice to War
subfiles.about: State requests customary courtesies for ONDO.
subfiles.summary: The note gives ONDO’s planned Los Angeles and Hilo dates.

subfiles.title: Approval of ONDO visits and weather clarification
subfiles.about: State approves ONDO’s calls and clarifies that weather may delay arrivals.
subfiles.summary: State contacts federal departments for courtesies and says weather should not cause arrivals ahead of schedule.

subfiles.title: Navy reports ERIMO early at Honolulu
subfiles.about: Navy reports ERIMO arrived in Honolulu one day ahead of schedule.
subfiles.summary: The reported arrival was February 25.

subfiles.title: State reply on ERIMO’s early arrivals
subfiles.about: State reports another warning to Japan about ERIMO’s early arrivals.
subfiles.summary: Phillips distinguishes weather delays from arrivals before announced dates.

subfiles.title: Complaint to Japan on ERIMO’s arrival dates
subfiles.about: State again requests adherence to announced arrival dates for Japanese public vessels.
subfiles.summary: The note says ERIMO reached both ports early, although it misstates the Los Angeles arrival date as February 11. It argues that weather normally causes delay rather than early arrival.

subfiles.title: File note on Japanese vessel schedules
subfiles.about: A cross-reference points to correspondence on Japanese vessel schedules.
subfiles.summary: The OCR leaves most source details unreadable.

subfiles.title: Navy reports ERIMO early at San Pedro
subfiles.about: Navy reports ERIMO reached San Pedro on February 10, one day early.
subfiles.summary: This supplements the earlier report of its early Honolulu arrival.

subfiles.title: Labor report on KAIO MARU at Hilo
subfiles.about: Labor reports KAIO MARU’s Hilo stay and the courtesies extended.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived December 29 and departed January 9 for the mandated South Sea Islands.

subfiles.title: Copy of Labor report on KAIO MARU
subfiles.about: A second copy records KAIO MARU’s Hilo visit.
subfiles.summary: It repeats the arrival, departure, and port-courtesy report.

subfiles.title: War Department reply on ONDO
subfiles.about: War orders commanders in California and Hawaii to assist ONDO.
subfiles.summary: The Ninth Corps Area and Hawaiian Department receive courtesy instructions.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of ONDO visit
subfiles.about: Navy has no objection to ONDO’s proposed visits.
subfiles.summary: Appropriate naval officials will be advised.

subfiles.title: Labor reply on ONDO
subfiles.about: Immigration officials are instructed to extend lawful courtesies to ONDO’s personnel.
subfiles.summary: The reply acknowledges the proposed Los Angeles and Hilo visits.

subfiles.title: Treasury reply on ONDO
subfiles.about: Treasury authorizes customs collectors to assist ONDO.
subfiles.summary: Collectors in Los Angeles and Honolulu are told to provide customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Japanese reply on ERIMO schedule
subfiles.about: Japan regrets ERIMO’s unannounced changes but questions State’s Los Angeles date.
subfiles.summary: The ambassador says Japanese authorities have received State’s request and notes that February 11 was the scheduled Los Angeles arrival.

subfiles.title: Correction of ERIMO arrival date
subfiles.about: State corrects its earlier statement of ERIMO’s Los Angeles arrival.
subfiles.summary: ERIMO actually arrived February 10, a day before the announced February 11 date.

subfiles.title: Conversation with the Japanese Ambassador
subfiles.about: Phillips personally asks the ambassador to prevent early Japanese vessel arrivals.
subfiles.summary: The ambassador promises to telegraph Tokyo and expects the matter to be resolved.

subfiles.title: Navy report on ONDO’s delayed itinerary
subfiles.about: Navy reports ONDO’s later arrivals and lack of formal advance notice.
subfiles.summary: ONDO reached Los Angeles April 1 and Hilo April 16; Navy says Japanese-language newspapers had reported the delays earlier.

subfiles.title: State protest on ONDO itinerary changes
subfiles.about: State asks Japan to give advance official notice when known itinerary changes occur.
subfiles.summary: The note contrasts ONDO’s announced March 29 and April 13 arrivals with its actual April 1 and April 16 arrivals. It points to earlier public reports of delay and says unannounced changes inconvenience American authorities.

subfiles.title: State advises Navy of ONDO response
subfiles.about: State says it is contacting the Japanese Embassy about ONDO’s changed itinerary.
subfiles.summary: The note acknowledges Navy’s April 21 report.

subfiles.title: Japanese Training Squadron visit request
subfiles.about: Japan requests courtesies for YAKUMO and IWATE during a Pacific and Atlantic cruise.
subfiles.summary: The ambassador identifies Vice Admiral Zengo Yoshida and Captains Toshihisa Nakamura and Kakuji Kakuda, and requests facilities for the ships and crews at the named ports.

subfiles.title: Japanese Training Squadron schedule
subfiles.about: The enclosure lists the squadron’s planned port calls from Seattle to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Stops include California, Panama, Havana, Baltimore, New York, and Honolulu.

subfiles.title: Training Squadron notice to Washington governor
subfiles.about: State requests customary courtesies for the Japanese Training Squadron.
subfiles.summary: The note encloses the ambassador’s letter and schedule for YAKUMO and IWATE.
